summary: INHEIRA v2.1 Automatic Creative Documentation™ — full backend + frontend QA. Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_auto_doc_v2_1.py with 16 new pytest cases covering (a) evidence module import + sensitivity buckets non-overlapping, (b) lyric_line CREATIVE event + sha256 content_hash + legacy session_events mirror row, (c) lyric_line_edited + lyric_line_removed, (d) 60-second same-target debounce merging two edits into one row with revision_count=2 + revisions[] carrying the newer hash+preview, (e) chat_message SENSITIVE — no raw text in payload, secure_reference to session_messages, reference_hash + content_hash both 64 chars, (f) identifier_generated with value in payload, (g) rights_updated (creative) + approval_signed (sensitive, participants only), (h) rightprint_updated has session_id=None (never attached to sess_96285667fb26), (i) file_uploaded with filename/content_type/size, (j) GET /evidence with since/kind/limit filters + ascending order, (k) checkpoints list contains an OPEN checkpoint that transitions to CLOSED on version submit, (l) populate-since returns all required keys + human-readable what_changed + participants, (m) version submit with source_event_ids+source_checkpoint_ids persists on the version doc and version_submitted event's references[] equals source_event_ids, (n) version_evidence_added event on POST evidence artifact, (o) acknowledgement_submitted SENSITIVE with secure_reference→creative_acknowledgements, (p) legacy /events endpoint still returns mirrored rows. Regression: 26/26 CEI Phase 1 tests still pass. Combined: 42/42 pytest cases pass in ~8s. Frontend: verified studio-documenting-indicator visible on session top bar; WRITE→Evolution navigation works; evolution-view-switcher renders FIVE buttons in exact order [view-live, view-documentary, view-filmstrip, view-graph, view-session]; live-evidence-stream renders with green 'DOCUMENTING LIVE · AUTOMATIC CREATIVE DOCUMENTATION™' ribbon + working-memory checkpoint badge; 46 live-event-* rows visible; SENSITIVE events surface with lock icon + 'HASH-ONLY' badge and sha256-truncated preview (no raw content); Document Version modal Step 01/08 shows the AUTOMATIC CREATIVE DOCUMENTATION™ populate box with docver-populate-btn; clicking it fetches populate-since, fires toast 'Populated from N evidence events', and shows docver-populated-summary chip with total + per-kind counts. Populate-then-submit persists source_event_ids and source_checkpoint_ids on the resulting version (verified via /versions POST returning them + version_submitted event references[] matching). Non-negotiable invariants all upheld: (1) sensitive payloads never leak raw content, (2) all content_hash values are 64-char sha256, (3) every creative_evidence_events row has a matching legacy session_events row with the same event_id, (4) auto-checkpoints are only surfaced in Live view header + populate flow, (5) source_event_ids on version == events returned by populate-since at submit time, (6) confidence_status/mci_status remain frozen at awaiting_* (regression-covered by test_cei_v2 test_status_frozen_after_full_documentation).
critical_code_review_comments: evidence.py debounce dedup uses payload.get('target_id') or payload.get('line_id') or payload.get('section'). Using bare 'section' as the debounce key means TWO different lyric writes in the same section within 60s (e.g. verse) collapse into ONE event with revision_count++ — this could hide a legitimately-new second line if no line_id was passed. Consider requiring an explicit dedup_target and never falling back to 'section'.
server.py is now 1951 lines. Extract routers (evidence/versions/rights/chat) into /app/backend/routers/ modules to stay under the 700-line guideline.

GET /api/sessions/{id}/evidence returns entire payload including secure_reference and full revisions[] for creative events. If a session has thousands of events this can be a large response — add server-side pagination (skip/cursor) rather than only limit.

rightprint_updated events with session_id=None never appear via the session-scoped /evidence endpoint. The platform-wide/creator RightsPrint timeline currently has no dedicated GET — surface a /api/rightprint/events or similar so the passive record is actually accessible to auditors.
seed_data_creation: Ran against seeded test@songright.com / sess_96285667fb26. Test suite appended ~5 versions + ~30 lyric lines + several TEST_AUTODOC_* artifacts/acks + a few chat/file/identifier events. Ledger is append-only by design — repeated runs grow evidence stream but do not break tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.1 Automatic Creative Documentation™ is fully green across BE + FE. Test suites: /app/backend/tests/test_auto_doc_v2_1.py (16, ~7s) and /app/backend/tests/test_cei_v2.py (26, ~2s). Frontend selectors verified: studio-documenting-indicator, studio-chapter-write, evolution-view-switcher, view-live/documentary/filmstrip/graph/session, live-evidence-stream, live-event-{event_id}, document-version-modal, docver-populate-btn, docver-populated-summary, docver-submit. For any future evidence-related iteration, remember: (a) sensitive payloads must be inspected via json.dumps().find(raw_text) to catch regressions; (b) debounce is target_id/line_id/section keyed — write TWO new lyric lines in same section within 60s to reproduce the potential false-merge described in critical_code_review_comments; (c) legacy session_events mirror keeps Song DNA / Studio Pulse rail working, do NOT remove it; (d) confidence_status/mci_status must stay frozen at their awaiting_* strings.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all tests passed. Two initial test failures were payload-shape mismatches on my side (splits SplitSchema requires 'role'; EvidenceArtifactCreate.content is a string; only 8 acknowledgement kinds — 'written'/'audio'/'video'/'signature'/'producer_note'/'engineer_note'/'witness'/'ai_summary' — no 'co_writer_ack').
